        phone_pwd=a['password']

# Login already done; get phone access token

print('phone_access_token_loaded', bool(phone_access_token))

# Search for recent text messages that likely contain movie/recommendation request
results_all = []
query='movie'
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp = apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=phone_access_token, query=query, only_latest_per_contact=False, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-created_at')
    page = resp
    msgs = page.get('success', []) if isinstance(page, dict) else page
    # Some APIs return directly list
    if isinstance(resp, dict) and 'success' in resp:
        msgs = resp['success']
    else:
        msgs = resp
    if not msgs:
        break
    results_all.extend(msgs)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(msgs), 'total', len(results_all))
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>10:
        break

print('total messages found with query', query, len(results_all))
# Print top few messages contents for inspection
for m in results_all[:10]:
    sender=m['sender']
    receiver=m['receiver']
    print('msg', m['text_message_id'], 'from', sender['name'], sender['phone_number'], 'to', receiver['phone_number'], 'at', m['sent_at'], 'text', m['message'][:80])

# Login to Simple Note
sn_pwd=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
print('sn_pwd_len', len(sn_pwd))
resp=apis.simple_note.login(username='gl.moore@gmail.com', password=sn_pwd)
print(resp)
sn_token=resp['access_token']

# Search notes likely related to movie recommendations / Tarantino
all_hits=[]
queries=['Tarantino','Quentin','movie','movies','recommendations']
for q in queries:
    page_index=0
    while True:
        r=apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=sn_token, query=q, tags=None, pinned=None, dont_reorder_pinned=None, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, sort_by=None)
        hits=r.get('success', []) if isinstance(r, dict) else r
        if not hits:
            break
        all_hits.extend([(h['note_id'],h['title'],q,h['pinned'],h['created_at'],h['updated_at']) for h in hits])
        print('query',q,'page',page_index,'hits',len(hits),'total',len(all_hits))
        page_index+=1
        if page_index>10:
            break

# Deduplicate by note_id
uniq={}
for note_id,title,q,pinned,created_at,updated_at in all_hits:
    uniq[note_id]= {'note_id':note_id,'title':title,'matched_queries':sorted(set([x[2] for x in all_hits if x[0]==note_id])),'pinned':pinned,'created_at':created_at,'updated_at':updated_at}
print('unique note hits',len(uniq))
for note_id in sorted(uniq)[:20]:
    print(uniq[note_id])
